title.narrative: Development of Applied Knowledge and Skills for Human Development in Maharashtra - (DAKSH) Maharashtra Program

description.narrative: DAKSH Maharashtra supports the skills reform agenda in Maharashtra and aims to improve training and entrepreneurship for market-led employment. The Program is centered around 4 proposed results areas: (i) institutional strengthening for high-quality market-relevant training with robust MIS systems; (ii) improving the quality and market relevance of skill development programs at the training provider level; (iii) enhancing access for women and disadvantaged groups; and (iv) expanding skills training and entrepreneurship through private-public partnerships (PPPs).
To improve skills and entrepreneurship training for enhanced employability in Maharashtra.

title.narrative: Trainees completing skill training and placed in apprenticeships (disaggregated by SC/ST and women)

baseline.value: Under Government program, (i) 160,373 trainees completed skill development programs, (ii) 172,845 individuals in apprenticeships

target.value: (i) Trainees completing skill development courses (disaggregated reporting) have increased by an additional 10 percent from baseline (ii) An additional 10 percent increase in apprenticeship placements from baseline

comment.narrative:
183,682 trainees have completed skills development courses up until now in FY26; this figure may be updated post the completion of FY26. For FY25, this figure was 152,634.
274,834 individuals have been placed as apprentices up until now in FY26; this figure may be updated post the completion of FY26. For FY25, this figure was 278,605.
